en.html:
Sasagawa Adjutant"Many enemy units deployed ahead! Coming toward this ship!"
Shishiku"Such manners. They've come all this way to receive us."
Shishiku"Very good. We shall return the courtesy. Seventeenth Assault Dragoon Regiment—"
Shishiku"ALL PERSONNEL, ARMOUR UP!!"

獅子吼「礼儀のなっている奴らだ。 　わざわざ出迎えに来たか」
獅子吼「宜しい。返礼する。 　第一七強襲竜騎兵連隊――」

Occupation Warrior C《Could be Zero. Yamato dragoons put the year of development in the name.》
Occupation Warrior A《By their old calendar this is 2600... achha, so the very latest model. Interesting.》
Occupation Warrior C《Heh, yes. Let's see what this little frontier country has produced.》
Occupation Warrior B《Right... Get in first. Keep their heads pressed down!》
